newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon ups Royal Plastics.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon ups Royal Plastics.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Ivy Schneider said she upgraded Royal Plastics Group Ltd to a strong buy from a buy.

-- The analyst said she expected the company's revenues to grow 23.5 percent in fiscal 1997 and 27.5 percent in fiscal 1998, and earnings to increase 24.6 percent to $0.87 per share in fiscal 1997 and 24.7 percent to $1.10 per share in 1998.
-- She said her target price for the stock was US$24 to US$25. The stock was trading at 17-1/4 Monday, unchanged from Friday. The stock was up a fraction on the Toronto exchange.
